label: Devin cuts every rule file at 16,384 bytes and AGENTS.md is 27,372 bytes, so line 183 is the last fully delivered line and every line from 184 down - including the Plan-before-acting bullet and all of section 2 GATE 4-6 and section 4's completion gates - never reaches a Devin session.

The 119-character AGENTS.md:186 Plan-before-acting bullet that iteration 3 priced at 30 tokens begins past byte 16,384, so mechanism 1's cheapest edit buys no protection on Devin, which is also the one runtime with no command surface to fall back on.

DSH receives no AGENTS.md at all: the only system-prompt row any repo artifact generates for a DSH run is the agent persona patch, and every other .dsh reference to AGENTS.md is a section-number citation rather than delivered text. Repo-side delivery only; the harness's own default loader is not evidenced here.

No advisor adapter arbitrates an injected step against card text already in context, because the contract declares the injected text non-authoritative by construction: the brief is advisory, never replaces explicit skill loading, and never blocks the prompt. A mechanism that wants an injected step obeyed must overturn its carrier's contract first.

On DSH the prompt-time injection is absent in a dispatched child twice over: prompt-advisor sits in the Interactive-only group switched off by the lineage marker, and the adapter accepts only a message whose source kind is user as the prompt, which a dispatcher-composed task stub is not.

DSH has no agent-file loader and no command loader and Devin carries no mirrored command surface, so the self-invoked-command mechanism has no command to invoke on either, and a shared step reference reachable only from a command is unreachable on both.

The advisor roster is six by contract - Claude, Codex, Cursor, Devin, Pi and the OpenCode plugin - and seven by runtime directory; DSH's adapter is documented only in injection-contract.md, which is also the only place its interactive-only qualifier appears.

Delivery, not cost, discriminates the five mechanisms: three of five - the AGENTS.md gate, the hook injection and the self-invoked command - are absent or unreachable on AGENTS.md-truncating or command-less runtimes, the shared step reference is reachable only through a path two runtimes lack, and only templates plus validate.sh has a carrier every runtime executes.

Any text a mechanism adds to a runtime rule file must sit inside that runtime's first 16,384 bytes or the mechanism must state a fallback, because beyond that boundary the text is not in the prompt on Devin.

A hook-injected step cannot be authoritative while the advisor contract declares injected text advisory-only, non-replacing and non-blocking; authority must come from resident text or from a check outside the prompt path.

AGENTS.md is 27,372 bytes against Devin's 16,384-byte per-file rule limit, so 10,988 bytes of the repository's root instruction file are outside a Devin session's prompt; .devin/SYNC.md records the related failure where the file arrived only as a path due to token limits.
DSH personas quote AGENTS.md content verbatim rather than relying on it, which is consistent with the root file not being delivered to a DSH run.
